items.title: Google Wallet lands on iOS in the US
items.why: Wallet consolidation of tickets and boarding passes raises the bar for card-linked travel perks delivered through mobile wallets.

items.title: Google wallet returns to Apple
items.why: Wallet placement on iPhone matters for agentic checkout; consider how card credentials can sit inside these wallets.
items.summary_ai: Google Wallet is returning to Apple iPhones, giving Google an early lead among agentic shoppers and competing with Stripe's Link wallet.
